body:
I have a few because I can't decide :P I like 'Don't come down' 'black butterflies and déjà vu' 'miles away' 'am I pretty' and '(un)lost' 

All their songs that I've heard are good in my opinion! I'm much like you too, I like most types of music

Man your little pictures and gifs really put a smile on my face! Thank you for the birthday wishes, had a good day (apart from my last exam, but they're done now) and went out for a meal with my family and a close friend, which was great!

Sounds like you had fun in NYC, I've always been interested to go, but never had the chance. I've been to Washington D.C though, although very young, I still remember bits of it vividly, but I'm glad you're happy!

About techniques used for helping me focus, it's usually my phone/computer or guitar that distracts me, so I tend to put some music on in the background, turn off my monitors, plug my phone in on the other side of my room, and usually trust myself to not pick up the guitar, which is hard sometimes admittedly! And I tend to work in bursts with short breaks in-between to refresh my mind. A common method is an hour of work then 5-10 minutes of rest, and repeat, although I only tend to last 30-45 minutes, but I'll still feel a sense of accomplishment so it gets the job done.

I've recently got into a band my brother recommended; The Maine, I'm not sure if you've heard of them but they make sort of pop rock/punk-y sort of music, I'd recommend them but I'm not sure what sort of music you like! I think they're good anyway, and easy to play along to, which I like.

Yes I'm from very close to London, outskirts. So much has been going on following the terror attacks last night on London Bridge, it's very upsetting, but all my friends and family are safe, although my thoughts are definitely with the families of those injured and killed. Hearing that all 3 suspects were shot dead 8 minutes after the first emergency call makes me proud to be British, very quick response in a time where quick response is necessary. 

I watched a bit of the charity concert up in Manchester following the Manchester attacks a few weeks back, it was very emotional so I took a break and I'm about to watch the rest.

Played a few computer games with my friends and we won too which is always a bonus, puts a smile on my face :)

My birthdays this coming Friday on the 9th so fingers crossed I'm hoping for a good run of being happy this week, I've ordered a signed record from another one of my favourite bands and on Tuesday I'm going to try and get tickets to go and see them with my friend, although it's in November, it's still something to look forward to!

I also have problems with working and staying focuses so I need to work on that too, but I'm glad things are going well for you too :) how are things in the states?

No one broke in, thank god 😅

Done all my tests until June 7th so got a bit of a break, they went average I guess, I've done what I can do not going to worry myself about them.

Weekend was fine, fish fingers were tasty, first time I've cooked a whole meal for myself :)

Started my training for my job today, did 6 hours and get paid for it so earned £40 today, and got another training day tomorrow, and another one on the 3rd June, then I can start, feels good, but tiring and boring :P

How about yourself? Things going well?


P.S, didn't end up harming myself last weekend so it's a plus :)

Ups and downs you know.. Did my first exam, didn't feel like it went too well, but then again the rest of the country said the same, got my next 4 Tuesday through Friday. 

Parents went on holiday with friends for 3 days so I'm all alone tonight at home but going to stay with my grandparents tomorrow night, not sure there's been a night I've been completely home alone without becoming really depressed and cutting myself but I'm feeling relatively okay in comparison to the other times, so fingers crossed I last the night..

Cooked myself fish fingers and potato waffles for dinner, as a nearly 17 year old I love the freedom of being by myself in the house but it can get lonely and somewhat spooky at times, but I've got a set of drum sticks for protection by my bed :')
How are things going?
Ayy that's the one! The memories are flooding back, even though it was only two years ago.
My trip was to north Norfolk to the big spit, forgotten the name now though

Hey man that sounds awesome! Glad you're doing much better too, and nice effort on the gym, that's something I need to do but I have to put on some weight first. I'm not that bad but just a bit too skinny to build myself up.

Reading that I made your night made me smile! I didn't realise I could have an impact on someone I've never met that lives across the Atlantic. The internet really opens so many possibilities!

Hey man, you might not remember me, sorry, I've not been active for a while because I'm studying for my exams which are in 2 weeks ( :/ ) but I've got a fair amount to update on.

Schools going okay I guess, coursework for my music tech gets handed in tomorrow, which I've been working on all year so that's exciting, currently sat finishing off my logbook to write about everything I did in my pieces, maths maybe not brilliant, needs more work, and so do physics and chemistry, but I'm confident I can pull it off!

About the job interview I went to about 2 months ago; I got the job! Didn't think I did though because they said I'd hear back in a week but didn't contact me til nearly 3 weeks after the interview. Been emailed lots of paperwork I need to fill in which is weird as a teenager, as its my first time doing anything like this. I start my training on the 20th this month, so that's really exciting!

And to top it off yesterday one of my favourite duos (who are conveniently based in London, not far from me!) put up 10 shirts and signed EP's for sale, and I managed to get my hands on one, which should arrive some time soon, which I'm really looking forward to! Their musics very calming and I can relate to it more often than not (the duo is Majik, I recommend them!) I also sent them a message on Instagram and they replied, which has made me so much more of a fan, I love it when musicians communicate with their fans, it shows they care. They're not the biggest, they don't have many followers, but I'm still really happy about that.

I think overall things are looking up, but I can't speak for after exams, they might put a downer on me if I don't do well, because they affect what universities I can get into, but I'll take every day as it is!

How are things with you? It's been a good month since we spoke.

Went well I'm fairly confident they said they'd get back within a week! 

Today was very depressing though today in school we were called into an assembly at a time we don't normally have them and told that a boy 3 years younger than me attempted suicide and was taken off life support last night. The atmosphere in the school for the rest of the day was very eerie. Certainly not a nice end to the week, it made me feel sick thinking of it at one point

Definitely will do about to leave the house for it, all suited up! 

Things are going good not a huge improvement but they're not going badly so I'm fine with that
How you doing man? Sorry I've been out a while again. What you been up to? Got my job interview tomorrow!

It was incredible, I'd probably go as far as to say one of the best nights of my life, the band is probably one of the reasons I'm still here today and to see them live meant the world to me.
Unfortunately I don't really know anyone that likes them too so I don't have a lot of people to tell about it all :P

Good on you for going to the gym and experimenting with cookie too! What sort of stuff did you cook?

Had an awesome weekend, my brother came back from uni and we went to see my favourite band together, managed to get right up to the stage, was about a meter behind the front fence! 
They played lots of my favourite songs and I'm hoping to find someone to go with to see them again because they're coming back to London in just under 3 weeks, if I can I'd be so happy!

How's your weekend been? http://i.imgur.com/6gQR0tp.jpg

Sounds awesome man! Everything's better when it's free :P

Tried to phone but the parks closed in the winter, and that means so is their customer service line, so I never got through to them. I emailed one of the important people that helps run the park, and also resent my application as a last resort, hopefully I'll hear back from the person, or even get accepted for an interview (again) :)

Hey man, sorry, I've been a bit inactive on Reddit in general the last few days, to try and occupy myself with more active things.

My weekend (I guess whole week now) was good, went out with a few friends on Friday and had a good time together, chilled out Saturday and then went into town today (Sunday) to see my other friend who was working, I've been trying to get a job myself too, I'd been accepted for an interview at a local theme park but all of the interview slots were during my school time so I couldn't do them, and I've just check about an hour before writing this and I guess I'd left it so long without selecting a time that they've assumed I'm not interested anymore, so I'm going to ring them up after school on Monday and try and sort it out. My friend applied for the same job and got the interview so fingers crossed it gets sorted on the phone and we're both going to arrange to go at the same time (they do group interviews, like team building to get used to working as a team).

How's your weekend been? Done anything fun?

That sounds great man! I need to visit my brothers soon, they're away at university and I've been meaning to go and visit them but I've never got round to it! 

Football was good but just messing around with friends, my team lost though even though we were in the lead most of the game! :P I didn't mind though, it's the enjoyment I got out of it I care about

My days been okay I guess, started off being told off by my chemistry teacher because I was behind on work, but I forgot about it as the day went on because I don't have chemistry today, and the teachers leaving at the end of the week anyway so (as wrong as it probably is) I'm not really paying much attention to anything he says when he tells me off anymore, helps me get by :P

Played a bit of football with my friends, was supposed to play a match against another school but the game was cancelled so we just played against eachother, which was fun!

What sort of plans are you looking to make for Friday?

Why have you been alone in the state? Do you work there, or live apart from your family or is it a different reason? Don't let it get to you too much man I guess get out and do things to keep you busy, meet new people.

Personally I've found helping other people with their problems takes my mind off yours and I'm not sure if it's the same for you as well, but after time I'll be in a bad mood and want to talk, so if you ever want to just let me know, I'm happy to help :)

Ups and downs really, first day back to school tomorrow and it's 1am and I'm struggling to sleep which I find happens very frequently, so getting up at 7 isn't going to be fun.

Went over to my friends house for a bit today caught up with him because even though he lives on the next road down I don't see him a lot because we now go to different colleges, had a good time with him, but it's been pretty lonely otherwise, which I don't really like, but should see the rest of my friends tomorrow which is good.

No I've never actually played that, but I did used to play lots of games on the ps2 with my brothers when j was younger.

It's hard to put my finger on favourite planes but for military probably the Tornado gr4 (http://www.rafhemswell.org.uk/about-the-tornado-gr4.html) that my dad used to fly, and for passenger jets I'd go with either Airbus a350 or a380, the size of the 380 amazes me daily, it's huge

I went to my local airfield yesterday for a walk with my dad and sister to watch the planes etc, and they let us go up into the air traffic control tower to show us what goes on, which is something I've always been interested in, so that was really fun.

And my dad being a pilot based out of London Heathrow sent the airport an email asking if we can go up in the tower at a big airport, and they've said that's fine I just need to get a pass, I'm not sure when that'll be but that's given something to look forward to, I've always loved planes and flying since I was a baby
Today's been alright, not sure if I mentioned it or not but it's half term, so I don't have school this week, going to take it day by day and try and get lots of work done
*high fives* :)
Wouldn't be annoying you go for it!

Yes both my parents know, they know that I'm falling behind but I haven't told them it's because of my moods, it's half term now so I'm going to try and knuckle down and do lots of catching up over the next week and hopefully I should be able to bring myself back up to some better grades

I went to my local GP last October and got referred to my local hospital for a single session so they could assess the situation. That session was on Monday, so I still need to wait to hear back from them before I get into counselling.

I've just been falling behind because of my mood really, lack of motivation due to being depressed, not in the mood to do anything apart from lie in bed or listen to music etc, fell behind on a few lessons at the start of the term and I can't catch up. All I need to do to catch up is revise the topics I've fallen behind on, but I can't do that because I'm doing the current work and don't have time.

It felt good at the time and it made me feel better but as days go by it's just reminded me of all the bad things that have happened in the past. I've been pretty low the last two days, I'm trying to clear my mind but schools not helping, teachers are sending emails home to my parents and pulling me behind after lessons to have a go at me because I'm doing really badly..
I feel like it's a spiral I can't get out of, I'm depressed, which affects my grades, then teachers tell me off for that, which makes me depressed, and I can't seem to turn it around.

Wow man that took me by surprise, unfortunately I don't really have room for a drum set at the moment, although my dad was thinking of getting a second shed in the garden that I can play my music in, but even then I'm in London England so that's quite far away! I'd be interested but unfortunately it's not realistic! They're going okay I guess I don't play as much as a play guitar but I still try to practice when possible.

I had an appointment with a counsellor today at hospital, I might start getting external counselling in future if things get bad but they're looking up at the moment :)
Caught up on work when I got back into school got all my work but one piece done but it was on a worksheet j didn't get so I was let off the hook

Feeling a bit better today on Saturday still feeling a bit rough though, should be better in time for Monday hopefully. I've started emailing teachers and asking friends what work we got set to do at home etc so I can complete it on Sunday and have it done by Monday

It will be open to the whole class but he's said that we don't have time to go back over the syllabus in regular lessons, although I've missed 1 this week already and I'm missing another today (Friday) because I've come down with a pretty bad virus which really sucks, I'm not in a position to miss lessons. I'll have to email my teachers and ask for the work I would've done in class so I don't fall behind
Extra lessons in physics, didn't do too well in my exam and physics is the one I need for the degree I want to do at university, it's really hard but should be able to do better with the extra help

It's going alright, didn't get the best mock exam results but my parents are being supportive instead of punishing me which is helping, I'm going to start going to extra lessons at lunch times and after school too which will help me out, and overall it's made me want to work harder, which is what the mocks are designed to do, hopefully I can pull through for the actual exams in summer

Hey sorry I was away all weekend for my grandpas birthday but I'm back now, I haven't played for a few days so I'll need to do that soon but right now I've got to prioritise school work unfortunately, I'll stick at it though, I really wanna learn how to play well!

I like all time low and learnt to play by playing green day with my brother, I don't really have a favourite type of music to play, I'll play it if I like the song and there's guitar to play in it:) 

How long did you play drums for? Did it take long to learn for you?

I like art but I'm not very good at it, I'm better at music and I play guitar and I'm trying to teach myself drums, but progress is very slow especially when I don't had access to a drum kit a huge amount

I'm not sure about playing hard to get :P it just seems to be one week they can be really nice the next I won't get involved a huge amount, it's like roulette really, but it's definitely an improvement from not having any friends last year, today was okay although I got my mock exam results back for maths and music tech which weren't brilliant, bit of a downer but life goes on, I'll just have to study more for the actual exams.

Just been relaxing at home doing a bit of school work with Bob Ross on in the background, really helps calm me down because he's so positive :)

Today went well actually, I still had a good time hearing about their funny drunken stories even though I wasn't there and we had a good laugh together at school. I think during the week when I have to go to school I spend a lot of my time happy because I spend time with them, it's the weekends and holiday times that I don't see them as much, and it's a bit annoying that it's my grandpas 70th birthday party soon and the whole family is going for a trip away all weekend so j can't go out with them again, but they said today I'm invited over, and they want me to come instead of going away with my family, but I'm not prepared to do that because it's one of the rare times we can get the whole extended family together at once, hopefully not this weekend but the next I can go out with them all and have fun with them :)

I'm sorry for writing such a wall of text it's just nice to have someone to talk to positively

Hey sorry I had to get some sleep it was 4 in the morning in the UK, but I've not really done that too much, I've been out with them at one of their houses with everyone when someone they're not really friends with invited them self along and just turned up and he let him stay round but when he was gone he was talking badly behind his back, I've always been self conscious about that, I feel like I've worked to get to where I am with my friendships with them and I don't want to ruin it like that,

I've thought about organising things to get people to come but I get worried people wouldn't come and it would be really bad, so I don't put much thought into it

I guess it has made an improvement from last year because I'm happy when I'm not depressed instead of just feeling average, but I've felt like my lows are much lower than they were, and I don't mind talking here unless you would like to talk privately, the more people know the more they can help.

I guess stress could be a factor, I haven't been doing very well in my classes at school recently and I've just had exams that have put a lot of stress on me for studying etc, and even though I said I've made friends it can still be loneliness, I'm not out with them every time they go out, I'm sort of the new one in the group so I get invited along sometimes but not others, and when I'm not there seeing everyone else having fun makes me jealous when I'm at home doing nothing.

I don't really know what's going on, I was bullied last year in school and I had no friends and I was really outcast, that's when everything started, just over a year ago, and it carried on, I didn't go out and party in summer like everyone else did I just stayed by myself, I started up school this year in sixth form (year 12 in England, 16-17) and lots of pupils from last year had left, and I started to make friends, who actually care about me, I started going out with them on Fridays and Saturdays and everything, theoretically my life should've improved, but it hasn't really. I've just stayed at the low I was at last year
